Name: gitsync
Description: Cloud-first git sync: fetch, compare local vs origin, align local to origin (reset --hard) if out of sync, then commit and push. Working directory changes are preserved via stash.

Mcp.Description: Cloud-first git sync. Fetches origin, compares local HEAD with origin/<branch>. If in sync: commits working directory changes and pushes. If out of sync: stashes changes, resets --hard to origin, restores stash, then commits and pushes. Pass force=true to skip confirmation when out of sync. Proxy uses git's system/env default.

path.description: Absolute path to a folder containing a git repository

force.description: Skip confirmation and proceed with cloud-first reset --hard when local and remote are out of sync
